Description: Founded in 2017, ARRIS® is an advanced technology company enabling the design and manufacture of the highest-performance products at scale. Additive Molding developed by ARRIS® is a patented software, materials, and high-volume production platform for creating continuous fiber-reinforced thermoplastic composite structures. Today, the team’s market reach includes portable electronics, footwear, bicycles, automotive, aerospace, industrial, and beyond, delivering lighter, more sustainable products Made To Outperform® across industries.
